case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70530.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

thank you for your offer and for the reliable cooperation. We would like to settle this in a way that works for both sides. We can commit for the longer term, which gives you planning security: 36 months. Our bottom-up estimate of the full cost is EUR 403.21 per unit before margin (cost:350020). move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €432.29 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.
Please note:
As to the should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length.
We appreciate your commitment to a 36-month contract, which provides mutual planning security.
While we note your cost estimate, our pricing must reflect the verified material and labor cost increases previously outlined.
To accommodate your request for 90-day payment terms alongside the 36-month agreement, we can revise our offer to €432.29 per unit.
Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
